sentences.en: Talking of Professor Smith, his assistant is hard of hearing.
sentences.zh: 说到史密斯教授，他的助理听力不太好。

sentences.en: My sister works as an assistant to a college professor.
sentences.zh: 我妹妹是大学教授的助手。

sentences.en: His official title at the company is Assistant to the President.
sentences.zh: 在公司里，他的正式职位是总裁助理。

senses.zh: 辅助的，助理的；有帮助的
